    Spec House

    Status: Completed

    Dates: 2025 to 2026

    Project Type: Residential New Construction 

    Heartwood Homes built this four home project on a mountaintop in Pikeville, overlooking the Sequatchie valley, from start to finish, as well as completed multiple services internally including land clearing, excavation, road building, sitework and footings, septic installation, hardwood installation, tile installation and finish carpentry. The project is just the beginning phase of this new venture from the developers at Saddle Ridge Retreat- check out their website for more info or to book a stay! 

    https://saddleridgeretreat.com
